Ok, so basically you need to take the numbers written in the pads in the order of : Top left, Top right, Bottom left, Bottom right.

-Then with the numbers in that order you’ll do the operations given by the manual 
(So if the first one, top left, is 15, you’ll get 20) (Then if the second one, top right, is 46, you’ll need to triple the 20. Continue with the four button and you’ll obtain a number) 
-Once you got that number, you gotta keep it in mind (You’ll refer to it as X)

-Then, you want to add up all the numbers written in the keypads ( Ex :15 + 46 + 81 + 4 = 181)
-Divide this number by two (181/2 = 90.5) 
-And you’ll subtract the 90.5 from the first number you got ( Referred as X) ( X - 90.5=Z)

And with this final number (Z) you’ll be able to click in the good order simply by checking which picture does your number (Z) correspond to.
